notes.title: Dragon Dodge Valley Game Launch
notes.content:
[b]It gives me great pleasure to announce the imminent launch of Dragon Dodge Valley![/b]

This fast paced and challenging game will put your abilities to dodge, weave and run from fireballs while shooting at dragons and a host of other enemies to the test!  Dare you challenge the denizens of dragon dodge valley!

It is my great hope that this game will give you many hours of pleasure, whether played as originally intended with the difficulty intact or as a casual experience with the cheats turned on while you enjoy watching those dragons die to your immortal hand.  Play the game your way, have fun your way as long as you have fun!

I look forward to releasing the game for you all to enjoy on [u][b]Friday 4th August[/b][/u].
